mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) consistently signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8.0% over a 3-month period indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) over the past two months indicates a broad-based economic slowdown in both housing demand and manufacturing supply, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and INDPRO fails to produce negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In low inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 2.0% annually), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary easing that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In low inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%), the decline in FEDFUNDS does not produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 700,000 units over a 2-month period signals weakening demand in the housing sector, a key component of consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 700.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a policy response to labor market deterioration, associated with recessionary outlook and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary policy easing amid labor market deterioration
failure_condition: The joint decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in UNRATE fails to produce negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In strong industrial production regimes (INDPRO > 100), an increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity and positive corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In strong industrial production regimes (INDPRO > 100), an increase in INDPRO does not produce positive 5-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.
